points.title: 贫苦农家少年
points.description: 彭德怀出生于湖南省湘潭县一个贫苦农民家庭，原名彭得华。童年时期家境贫寒，只读过两年私塾，后因家庭无力承担学费而辍学。这段经历使他对农民的苦难有深刻体会，也培养了他反抗压迫的性格。1916年，他离开家乡投身湘军，开始了军旅生涯，这段早期经历为他后来的军事才能和革命思想奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Peng Dehuai was born into a poor peasant family in Xiangtan County, Hunan Province, originally named Peng Dehua. His family was so impoverished that he only attended private school for two years before dropping out due to financial constraints. This experience gave him a deep understanding of the suffering of peasants and fostered his rebellious character against oppression. In 1916, he left his hometown and joined the Hunan Army, beginning his military career, which laid the foundation for his later military abilities and revolutionary ideas.

points.title: 红军创建者
points.description: 1928年，彭德怀率部参加秋收起义后，与朱德、毛泽东在井冈山会师，成为中国工农红军的重要创始人之一。他参与领导了井冈山革命根据地的建设，在军事指挥上展现出卓越才能。在中央苏区时期，他担任红三军团军团长，参与指挥了多次反'围剿'战斗，为保卫革命根据地做出了重要贡献。这一时期，他逐渐成长为红军的重要军事领导人，形成了自己独特的军事指挥风格。
points.descriptionEn: In 1928, after leading troops in the Autumn Harvest Uprising, Peng Dehuai met Zhu De and Mao Zedong at Jinggangshan, becoming one of the important founders of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. He participated in leading the construction of the Jinggangshan revolutionary base area, demonstrating outstanding military command abilities. During the Central Soviet period, he served as commander of the Third Red Army Corps, participating in commanding multiple battles against 'encirclement and suppression campaigns,' making significant contributions to protecting the revolutionary base areas. During this period, he gradually grew into an important military leader of the Red Army, developing his unique military command style.

points.title: 抗日名将
points.description: 彭德怀参与并领导了长征，担任红一方面军司令员，在遵义会议后坚定支持毛泽东的领导。抗日战争爆发后，他担任八路军副总司令，直接指挥了百团大战等重大战役，沉重打击了日军。在华北战场，他领导创建了晋察冀、晋绥等抗日根据地，为抗日战争的胜利做出了卓越贡献。解放战争时期，他担任中国人民解放军副总司令，参与指挥了西北战场的多次重大战役，为解放大西北立下赫赫战功。
points.descriptionEn: Peng Dehuai participated in and led the Long March, serving as commander of the First Front Army. After the Zunyi Conference, he firmly supported Mao Zedong's leadership. After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, he served as deputy commander of the Eighth Route Army, directly commanding major campaigns such as the Hundred Regiments Offensive, dealing heavy blows to the Japanese army. On the North China battlefield, he led the creation of anti-Japanese base areas like Jin-Cha-Ji and Jin-Sui, making outstanding contributions to the victory of the Anti-Japanese War. During the War of Liberation, he served as deputy commander-in-chief of the People's Liberation Army, participating in commanding major campaigns on the Northwest battlefield, making brilliant achievements in liberating Northwest China.

points.title: 志愿军总司令
points.description: 1950年朝鲜战争爆发后，彭德怀被任命为中国人民志愿军司令员兼政治委员，率军入朝作战。在极端困难的条件下，他指挥志愿军与装备精良的联合国军作战，取得了五次战役的重大胜利，迫使美国回到谈判桌前。彭德怀在朝鲜战场上展现出的军事才能和坚定意志，为新中国赢得了国际尊重，也奠定了他在党和国家领导人中的重要地位。然而，长期的战争环境也使他的健康状况严重恶化，为后来的疾病埋下了隐患。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the Korean War in 1950, Peng Dehuai was appointed Commander and Political Commissar of the Chinese People's Volunteers, leading troops to Korea. Under extremely difficult conditions, he commanded the Volunteers to fight against the well-equipped UN forces, achieving major victories in five campaigns, forcing the United States back to the negotiating table. Peng Dehuai's military talent and firm will shown on the Korean battlefield won international respect for New China and also established his important position among the party and state leaders. However, the long-term war environment also severely damaged his health, laying the groundwork for later illnesses.

points.title: 蒙难与抗争
points.description: 1959年庐山会议上，彭德怀因对大跃进政策提出批评意见而被错误批判，被打成'反党集团'头目，随后被撤销一切职务。文化大革命期间，他遭受了更严重的迫害，被长期监禁和批斗。尽管身处逆境，彭德怀始终坚持原则，拒绝认罪，表现出了共产党人的铮铮铁骨。1974年，他在北京含冤去世，直到1978年才得到平反昭雪。彭德怀的晚年经历反映了他作为一个正直军人的品格，也成为了中国历史上敢于直言进谏的典范。
points.descriptionEn: At the 1959 Lushan Conference, Peng Dehuai was wrongly criticized for his critical opinions on the Great Leap Forward policy, labeled as the head of an 'anti-party clique,' and subsequently stripped of all positions. During the Cultural Revolution, he suffered more severe persecution, being long-term imprisoned and subjected to struggle sessions. Despite being in adversity, Peng Dehuai consistently upheld principles, refused to confess false charges, demonstrating the unyielding character of a communist. He died in Beijing in 1974, exonerated only in 1978. Peng Dehuai's later years reflected his character as an upright military officer and became a model in Chinese history for daring to speak truth to power.

appraisal.zh: 彭德怀一般被评价为战功卓著而又命运坎坷的军事家：革命战争与朝鲜战场上的指挥才能广受认可，庐山会议上直言进谏则被视为其刚直品格的体现，也由此酿成个人悲剧。学界主流肯定他的军事贡献与坚持真理的勇气，同时指出其政治上的直率与不够灵活。另一种看法认为，他对大跃进的批评虽出于好意，方式却欠妥当，对游击战重视不足，政治智慧与战略眼光存在局限。
appraisal.en: Peng Dehuai is generally assessed as a commander of outstanding battlefield achievement and tragic fate: his leadership in the revolutionary wars and in Korea is widely recognized, while his blunt remonstrance at Lushan is seen as evidence of an upright character and as the source of his personal tragedy. Mainstream scholarship affirms his military contribution and his courage in upholding truth, while noting his political directness and lack of flexibility. Another view holds that his criticism of the Great Leap Forward, though well-intentioned, was poorly judged in method, that he underrated guerrilla warfare, and that his political wisdom and strategic vision had clear limits.

supporter.zh: 彭德怀是中国人民解放军的杰出将领，被誉为'红军之父'和'抗日名将'。他忠诚于党和人民，在革命战争中立下赫赫战功，特别是在朝鲜战争中展现了卓越的军事才能和坚定的革命意志。彭德怀敢于直言进谏，坚持真理，不盲从权威，体现了共产党人的高尚品格。他的军事思想和指挥艺术对中国革命和军队建设产生了深远影响，是中国历史上不可磨灭的英雄人物。
supporter.en: Peng Dehuai was an outstanding commander of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, hailed as the 'Father of the Red Army' and a 'famous anti-Japanese general.' He remained loyal to the Party and the people, making brilliant military achievements in revolutionary wars, especially demonstrating outstanding military talent and firm revolutionary will during the Korean War. Peng dared to speak truth to power, uphold truth, and not blindly follow authority, reflecting the noble character of a communist. His military thought and command art had a profound impact on the Chinese revolution and army construction, making him an indelible heroic figure in Chinese history.

critic.zh: 彭德怀在政治上存在局限性，他在庐山会议上对大跃进的批评虽然出于好意，但方式方法不够恰当，未能充分理解当时的历史背景。他在军事指挥上有时过于强调正规战，对游击战的重要性认识不足。此外，他在处理与毛泽东的关系上过于直率，缺乏政治灵活性，最终导致了自己的政治悲剧。这些批评者认为，彭德怀虽然是一位优秀的军事家，但在政治智慧和战略眼光上存在明显不足。
critic.en: Peng Dehuai had political limitations. Although his criticism of the Great Leap Forward at the Lushan Conference was well-intentioned, his approach was not appropriate enough, failing to fully understand the historical context at that time. In military command, he sometimes overemphasized regular warfare while not fully recognizing the importance of guerrilla warfare. Additionally, he was too straightforward in his relationship with Mao Zedong, lacking political flexibility, which ultimately led to his political tragedy. These critics argue that although Peng was an excellent military strategist, he had clear deficiencies in political wisdom and strategic vision.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，彭德怀被视为一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是战功卓著的军事家，也是敢于直言的政治家；既是忠诚的共产党员，又是悲剧性的受害者。彭德怀的一生反映了中国革命和建设的复杂历程，他的军事才能和革命精神得到广泛认可，而他的悲剧命运也引发了人们对历史和个人命运的深刻思考。在流行文化中，彭德怀常被塑造成敢于坚持真理、不畏强权的英雄形象，成为中国历史上'为民请命'的典型代表。
objective.en: In historical academia, Peng Dehuai is viewed as a complex and contradictory historical figure. He was both a brilliant military strategist and a forthright politician; both a loyal communist and a tragic victim. Peng's life reflects the complex course of China's revolution and construction. His military talent and revolutionary spirit are widely recognized, while his tragic fate has also prompted deep reflection on history and individual destiny. In popular culture, Peng is often portrayed as a hero who dared to uphold truth and resist power, becoming a typical representative of 'speaking for the people' in Chinese history.

self.zh: 我为人民利益而死，虽死犹生。
self.en: I die for the interests of the people, though dead, I am still alive.
